title: Replacing an empty document with a scalar writes it after the start marker, before the marker comment
notes: The document is `---` with a comment and no content, so its root is empty (null). A scalar root is written on the marker line after `---`, and the comment, which is outside the node, stays after it, still separated from the scalar by a space. The specification also allows the scalar on the next line (`edit/replace-empty-document-keeps-marker-comment` puts a mapping there, which cannot share the marker line); that a scalar goes on the marker line is a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend refused the edit, saying the comment would belong to another owner; the pure backend wrote the expected bytes.
